researchEvidence.title: Company evidence — English research pilot
researchEvidence.scope: Manually selected public-company notes. These companies are not added to your holdings. Microsoft is an unfunded watchlist example.
researchEvidence.date: Prepared 25 October 2026. Reporting periods below are historical; this is not a live data feed.
researchEvidence.limit: Selected-source coverage only. Later announcements may change these conclusions. PDF table extraction and arithmetic were checked; visual PDF review is incomplete.
researchEvidence.personal: These notes do not use your plan or portfolio and do not establish suitability, an entry price or a buy/sell instruction. No current quote, broker costs, tax or currency outcome is assessed.

ongc.title: ONGC — distinguish parent and group profit
ongc.period: Quarter ended 30 June 2026 / quarter ended 30 June 2025. Amounts: ₹ crore. Unaudited results with limited review.
ongc.interpretation: Calculated interpretation: standalone profit rose about 112%, owners’ profit about 21%, while total group profit fell about 43%. Owners plus noncontrolling interests reconcile to total profit in both periods. These headlines can all be correct.
ongc.filing: NSE filing · 4 August 2026 · PDF pages 6 and 21
ongc.management: Management attributes HPCL losses to petroleum product under-recoveries and describes production difficulties. Offshore project benefits are expected progressively from FY2027–28; this is guidance, not achieved production.
ongc.conclusion: Research implication: review upstream performance, downstream losses and group funding together before treating one strong quarter as durable growth. Do not annualise the quarter into a forecast.
ongc.gaps: Still needed: normalised earnings across the commodity cycle, cash funding, debt and project delivery. No valuation target has been established.

microsoft.title: Microsoft — profit growth and infrastructure cash needs
microsoft.period: Fiscal years ended 30 June 2026 and 2025. Cash amounts: USD millions; EPS: USD per diluted share.
microsoft.earnings: FY2026 GAAP EPS was $17.95; company-adjusted EPS was $17.28. The adjustment excludes OpenAI investment effects, not every unusual item. The release separately describes an Anthropic gain and other quarterly items.
microsoft.cash: Operating cash: 182,935 versus 136,162. Cash equipment additions: 115,948 versus 64,551. Calculated difference: 66,987 versus 71,611. Operating cash grew about 34%, while that difference fell about 6.5%.
microsoft.proxy: This difference is a limited cash proxy, not full owner earnings. It does not adjust for stock compensation, acquisitions, finance leases or all capital commitments.
microsoft.annual: Microsoft FY2026 annual report · cash flow statement
microsoft.conclusion: Research implication: keep as a watchlist test case. Examine whether infrastructure spending produces durable incremental cash before choosing a valuation basis. Profit growth alone does not establish an attractive price.
microsoft.gaps: Still needed: current disclosures and quote, lease obligations, dilution, spending returns and an explicitly reviewed valuation scenario. No funded purchase is assumed.

researchRecommendation.title: Research recommendation and explanation — English beta
researchRecommendation.watchlistAction: The checked annual growth and cash-generation conditions are met. Put this company on a research shortlist, then assess its price and business risks before considering a purchase. If you already hold it, review valuation and your investment thesis before changing exposure.
researchRecommendation.review-riskAction: Pause new buying while you investigate the concerns below. If you already hold this stock, review whether those concerns weaken your investment thesis or exceed your risk limits. This screen alone is not a reason to sell.
researchRecommendation.wait: Wait — the purchase case is not established
researchRecommendation.waitAction: Keep this as a research candidate until the missing checks are completed or the evidence improves. If you already hold it, update your research before deciding to add, hold or sell.
researchRecommendation.scope: Recommended next research action from annual financial data. A buy/sell verdict and target price are unavailable because valuation and personal suitability have not been assessed. This is rule-based, not AI.
researchRecommendation.reasonsEmpty: No supporting condition was established by this limited screen.
researchRecommendation.concernsEmpty: No listed annual warning condition was triggered. This does not mean the company is safe or that all risks were checked.
researchRecommendation.gaps: Checks still needed before a buy/sell decision
researchRecommendation.method: Screen rules v1: the watchlist outcome requires two adjacent annual periods, rising revenue and profit, positive prior profit and operating cash, latest operating cash at least equal to profit, assets above nonnegative liabilities, no listed warning, and a latest annual period within 18 calendar months. Known specialist sectors require separate analysis. Otherwise the result is wait or risk review. These are transparent screening choices, not validated return forecasts or ratings. Reports and recommendations remain temporary. See the source details below.

researchChart.tradePointNote: A reported trade snapshot, not a completed candle. No OHLC or volume is inferred.
researchChart.timeAxis: Candle date / time (IST). Daily ticks show the session date; midnight daily timestamps are not trade times.
researchChart.interactHelp: Hover or tap a point to inspect its date/time and prices. Use Zoom in/out and Earlier/Later to change the view. Reset view shows the complete selected period. Arrow keys also inspect points.
researchChart.indiaScope: View price history and a timestamped exchange quote for the selected listing. Optional updates every 15 seconds while this chart is open and visible; this is snapshot polling, not a tick-by-tick stream. Only the public listing and the server-held provider credential go to Upstox.
researchChart.error: Chart could not be updated. Automatic updates stop after an error; use Refresh to retry. Check the provider connection or wait if another research request is busy. An old chart is not substituted.
researchChart.stale: The last trade is more than two minutes old. The market may be closed, the stock may be inactive, or the feed may be stale. A recent fetch does not make the trade recent.
researchChart.empty: No candles were returned for this range. Today may have no trading session yet; choose a longer range. No previous session is silently substituted.
researchChart.candleNote: Source: Upstox. Line points show reported candle closes against their actual timestamps. Gaps do not imply recorded trades between points. Zooming uses only the data already loaded. The latest candle may be incomplete. Adjustment for splits/dividends is not established, so this is not a total-return chart. The separate last-trade dot uses the reported price and trade timestamp; it is not a completed candle. It is shown only at the latest edge of the view, never as invented OHLC or volume. Charts do not change the recommendation or saved portfolio.
researchChart.usScope: Optional external chart for a ticker reported by the matched SEC company. Choose its exchange before opening. Treat US data as delayed or limited-venue coverage; read the provider’s timestamp and data-status label. Real-time consolidated US prices are not promised.
researchChart.externalPrivacy: Opening the chart contacts TradingView from this device and sends the public listing plus browser connection metadata. This app does not send portfolio data, investor-plan answers or API keys to it. Close or leave the report to unload the chart.
researchChart.listingNote: Verify the exchange and share class against the company’s listing. Exchange choice is manual and is not reconciled to SEC identity. An unavailable symbol will not be silently replaced with another listing.
researchChart.noTicker: No supported ticker was supplied by the SEC report. A chart cannot be safely selected from a company name alone.
researchChart.providerUnavailable: If the provider blocks embedding or reports an unavailable symbol, use the TradingView link to inspect that exact listing. No alternate ticker or paid feed is selected automatically.

researchValuation.title: Price and earnings check
researchValuation.scope: Optional worksheet using reviewed inputs. P/E = price ÷ positive diluted earnings per share for one full year. Enter dates and source links; no default price, earnings forecast or P/E assumption is invented. Inputs and results stay on this screen only and are cleared when the report is cleared or you leave.
researchValuation.indiaNote: The Indian summary does not establish attributable diluted EPS. Copy full-year diluted EPS from a reviewed company filing in the selected standalone/consolidated basis. Never divide group profit by an unverified share count or treat INR crore as INR per share.
researchValuation.usNote: Where available, the latest annual diluted EPS and its filing are prefilled from the SEC report. Review them: these are annual figures, not automatically trailing-twelve-month earnings. Enter the dated USD quote yourself; the chart widget is not a valuation-data API.
researchValuation.confirmation: I checked that the quote and diluted EPS refer to this same company, share class, currency and split-adjusted share basis. The EPS covers one full year in the stated reporting basis and was publicly available by the price date. I reviewed exceptional items; this check does not verify them for me.
researchValuation.confirm: Review the sources, share basis and dates, then confirm the checkbox. Changing any input requires confirmation again.
researchValuation.numbers: Enter a positive price and a finite EPS using plain decimal numbers (up to eight decimal places, no commas).
researchValuation.dates: Use valid dates: one full-year EPS period (330–380 days), period end on/before publication, publication before price date (same-day quotes are excluded because publication time is unknown), and price date on/before today. This prevents using unpublished earnings in a historical price comparison.
researchValuation.sources: Both source fields need a complete https URL without embedded credentials. Links are recorded here as your input, not independently fetched or verified.
researchValuation.loss: P/E and earnings yield are not shown for zero or negative EPS. An earnings-multiple price is not meaningful here; review cash, solvency and an appropriate alternative valuation method.
researchValuation.multipleError: If using a P/E assumption, enter a positive value up to 1,000 and explain it. It is your scenario assumption, not a recommended market multiple.
researchValuation.ages: Calendar days: price age today / EPS period-end age at price date:
researchValuation.stale: Older inputs: the price is over seven days old or the earnings period ended over 550 days before that price. These are app review flags, not exchange standards. Check newer quotes/results before relying on this comparison.
researchValuation.scenario: Price implied by your P/E assumption
researchValuation.interpretation: A lower P/E alone does not establish a bargain. Compare sustainable earnings, growth, leverage, sector peers and history on the same basis. Earnings yield is not dividend yield, cash yield or a forecast return. An assumed-multiple price is not a fair-value conclusion or price target.
researchValuation.limitations: This worksheet does not change the annual-data recommendation, use your portfolio or assess personal buy/sell suitability. It omits dividends, fees, taxes, FX, dilution forecasts and future earnings. Do not use it as a total-return forecast. No inputs are sent to AI or saved as a report. Text is English beta in other interface languages.

researchRatios.title: Company and sector ratios — Upstox
researchRatios.scope: Optional public-company ratios using your existing Upstox connection. Load explicitly; no automatic polling or saved report. Only the selected public listing and the server-held provider credential go to Upstox. This does not read your holdings or send data to AI.
researchRatios.error: Ratios could not be loaded. Check the connection or retry after other research finishes. No previous result is substituted; your financial report remains available.
researchRatios.gaps: Provider summary: quote/as-of date, earnings period, standalone/consolidated basis, calculation adjustments and sector-member methodology are not established by this response. A recent fetch does not establish current inputs. These ratios are separate from the selected financial-statement basis and are not inserted into the reviewed EPS worksheet.
researchRatios.caption: Reported company and sector values; unavailable values stay unknown
researchRatios.definition0: Share price relative to earnings per share. Check sustainable earnings, share class and period.
researchRatios.definition1: Share price relative to book equity per share. Asset quality and sector matter.
researchRatios.definition2: Reported return on assets; accounting definitions and averaging can differ.
researchRatios.definition3: Reported return on equity; leverage or low/negative equity can distort it.
researchRatios.definition4: Reported return on capital employed; verify the capital and profit definitions.
researchRatios.definition5: Enterprise value relative to EBITDA. It omits capex, working capital, interest and taxes.
researchRatios.nonpositive: Nonpositive multiple: not a normal positive-earnings/book-value comparison.
researchRatios.interpretation: A lower multiple than the sector does not establish that a stock is cheap; a higher return ratio does not establish a safe investment. Sector composition, leverage, accounting, losses and growth expectations can differ. No target, fair value, numerical score or personal buy/sell recommendation is produced, and the annual-data screen is unchanged. English beta in other interface languages.

reviewedImport.title: Review and save settled holdings
reviewedImport.scope: Enter ordinary shares from a dated broker record. This saves a holdings snapshot; it does not place trades. Your draft stays on this screen until you confirm it.
reviewedImport.saveSteps: To save: complete the record, tap Preview before saving, then review the preview and tap Confirm and save this snapshot. Nothing is saved by the preview alone.
reviewedImport.accountSetupRequired: Add a holdings account above before entering stocks here.
reviewedImport.newAccountNote: Use an account nickname and its statement currency. This creates an empty local account, without connecting a broker or fetching exchange rates.
reviewedImport.accountFailed: The account could not be confirmed. Check your sign-in and retry without changing its name or currency; this reuses the same request and avoids duplicates after a lost response.
reviewedImport.sourceDateHelp: Use the date these settled quantities were confirmed by the broker, not the day you bought the shares.
reviewedImport.priceDateHelp: The price must be dated on or before the holdings record. Leave all three price fields blank if no suitable dated price is known.
reviewedImport.priceAfterRecord: The price date is later than the holdings-record date. Check the date the holdings record represents (not the purchase date), or clear the price, price date and price source if no suitable dated price is known.
reviewedImport.sourceAccount: Source account nickname (no account number needed)
reviewedImport.complete: All settled holdings in this account
reviewedImport.otherExposure: Other positions, unsettled shares or pledged holdings
reviewedImport.unknownNote: Leave cash, average cost and price blank when unknown. Enter 0 only when you know it is zero. A price needs its own date, source and exchange. Find each share’s ISIN in the broker’s holding details or statement.
reviewedImport.name: Company / share name
reviewedImport.ordinaryEquity: I checked the ISIN: this is an ordinary equity share, not an ETF, fund, derivative or depositary receipt.
reviewedImport.invalid: Check the account, source, date, ISIN, exchanges and quantities. Confirm each share type. If you enter a price, include its date and source. Amounts support up to 8 decimal places.
reviewedImport.failed: This request could not be completed. Check your sign-in and inputs, then prepare a fresh preview if the account or record changed. If a save response was lost, retrying the same confirmation is safe.
reviewedImport.expired: This preview expired. Prepare a new preview before saving.
reviewedImport.savedReloadFailed: The save was confirmed, but its record could not be reloaded. Use Reload saved holdings after checking your connection.
reviewedImport.saved: This snapshot is saved. Review the reloaded record below.
reviewedImport.historyUnavailable: This snapshot has no trade, tax, acquisition-date or performance history. Unknown cash, costs and prices remain unknown; incomplete snapshots cannot support complete portfolio totals.
reviewedImport.statusError: The personal import status could not be checked. Refresh to try again.

warnings.SNAPSHOT_ONLY_NO_TRADE_OR_TAX_HISTORY: This is a holdings snapshot, with no trade or tax history.
warnings.SOURCE_DATE_IS_HISTORICAL: The source record is historical; these are not verified current holdings.
warnings.SETTLED_SCOPE_PARTIAL: Only some settled holdings are included.
warnings.OTHER_EXPOSURE_UNRESOLVED: Other exposure has not been ruled out or reconciled.
warnings.PURCHASE_COST_UNKNOWN: At least one holding has an unknown average cost.
warnings.MARKET_PRICE_UNKNOWN: At least one holding has no observed market price.
warnings.PRICE_DATE_DIFFERS_FROM_SNAPSHOT: At least one price is from a different date than the holdings record.

changes.changed: Details changed since its previous snapshot
changes.removed_from_complete_snapshot: Absent from this complete snapshot; no sale or trade is inferred
changes.not_covered_by_partial_snapshot: Not covered by this snapshot; no sale or trade is inferred

personal.modeError: The app could not verify its private operating mode. Refresh before continuing.
personal.modeChanged: The server’s operating mode changed. Reload the app to clear this session before opening it again.
personal.savedScope: Choose an account to see its saved, dated holdings record. This view does not refresh your broker or fetch prices. It shows no combined portfolio total or performance calculation.
personal.noAccounts: No personal holdings accounts yet. Open Review / manage holdings to create one and preview a dated record.
personal.recordError: This saved record could not be verified. Refresh or check your sign-in; no replacement values have been assumed.
personal.noSnapshot: This account has no saved holdings snapshot yet.
personal.metalsPending: Precious-metals prices and MCX contracts are not connected in this personal release yet. No price, currency conversion or investment recommendation is available here.
